title: Story writer
description:
**Role Overview** PlotPix is building an AI native microdrama platform for mobile first, vertical storytelling. We create emotionally addictive, binge worthy fiction designed for short episode formats and fast audience payoff.

We are looking for a creative **Story Writer** who can create stories people feel compelled to continue. This is not a pure script formatting role. We already use AI heavily for speed and execution. What we need most is a strong creative mind with sharp instinct for storytelling, emotional progression, character build up, audience pull, narrative rhythm, and what makes a viewer care.

You should be someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into a compelling story engine. Someone who naturally thinks in terms of tension, reversals, chemistry, obsession, secrets, payoffs, emotional spikes, and binge flow.

This role is for people who are excited by new \*\*storytelling formats, can adapt to new audiences quickly, and can use AI as a multiplier rather than as a crutch. \*\*

**What You’ll Do**

* Create original microdrama story concepts with strong audience appeal
* Build lead characters viewers get emotionally invested in, root for, obsess over, hate, or can’t ignore
* Design high retention story arcs with clear emotional movement across episodes
* Shape narration flow, emotional flow, reveals, reversals, cliffhangers, and payoff moments
* Develop stories that feel highly bingeable in a short form vertical format
* Explore multiple creative directions for the same premise and identify the strongest one
* Adapt stories across genres, tones, and audience segments based on brief, platform need, or viewer response
* Work with AI tools to accelerate ideation, expansion, variation, and iteration
* Push past generic ideas and predictable beats to find fresher, sharper story turns
* Collaborate closely with directors, editors, and creative leads to refine stories from concept to final narrative
* Rewrite with intent, not just polish. Improve emotional impact, clarity, pace, and viewer pull
* Continuously learn what works for new formats, new markets, and changing audience tastes

**What We’re Really Looking For**

* Strong instinct for storytelling over scripting
* Strong sense of emotion over exposition
* Strong sense of viewer psychology over technical correctness
* Ability to create characters, conflict, tension, attraction, betrayal, longing, power shifts, and payoff
* Ability to judge whether a story feels flat, forced, repetitive, too safe, too slow, or not emotionally sticky
* High creative aptitude and fast pattern recognition
* Comfort with ambiguity, experimentation, and non traditional workflows
* Curiosity about what different audiences respond to and why
* Ability to use AI effectively while still bringing original taste and judgment

**Ideal Candidate** You may come from fiction writing, screenwriting, web series, audio drama, serialised content, fan fiction communities, creator writing rooms, ad films, narrative design, or any form of storytelling where audience pull matters.

**What matters most is that you can:**

* Think of strong stories fast
* Build characters people care about
* Sustain emotional momentum
* Adapt to feedback without making the story bland
* Create for modern mobile audiences without sounding synthetic or derivative

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in short form fiction, web series, episodic storytelling, romance, thriller, drama, or youth content
* Understanding of Gen Z and young adult entertainment patterns
* Familiarity with cliffhanger design, binge loops, and retention driven storytelling
* Experience using AI tools for brainstorming, iteration, or story development
* Comfort working in a fast paced creative environment with frequent iteration

**Experience** *We are open on background. Years matter less than story instinct. You could be a fit if you have: 3 to 5 years in fiction, screenplay, episodic, digital, or narrative writing or A strong portfolio that shows exceptional storytelling ability, even without conventional experience*

**What Success Looks Like In this role, success means:**

* You consistently generate strong story ideas, not just clean pages
* Your characters feel emotionally alive
* Your episode flows create pull and continuation
* Your stories adapt well to new formats and audience needs
* You improve the quality of the story, not just the wording of the script

**What We Offer**

* Working with a highly skilled, motivated and passionate group of people.
* Exposure to the full product development process from ideation to launch.
* Our culture of experimentation and creativity allows everyone to explore new ideas and approaches and think outside the box.
* Building a product for the global audience.
* A full pantry of munchies.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 EarthSync is a pioneering AI\-powered platform dedicated to accelerating industrial and commercial decarbonisation (reducing greenhouse gas emissions). We provide advanced software for renewable energy forecasting and financial optimisation, empowering businesses to plan, procure, and operate clean energy efficiently and cost\-effectively. Our mission is to leverage cutting\-edge technology to build a greener, more sustainable future.
 



**Role Description** 
 EarthSync is seeking a sharp, fast\-learning Software Development Engineer to join our core team early in its journey. This is a rare chance to grow as an engineer while working directly with the founders on products that matter at the intersection of AI and the energy transition.
 



 You'll work across the whole stack: you'll move between machine learning, neural networks, agentic workflow development, time\-series forecasting, data pipelining, optimisation, backend, and frontend as the work demands. You'll learn fast, ship real code in your first weeks, and see your work drive decisions for enterprise customers in the energy sector.
 



  





**Why Join EarthSync?** 



* **Build From Day Zero:** 
 Join a small founding team where your code ships to production immediately and your growth compounds quickly. You'll learn more here in a year than most engineers do in three.
* **Solve a Real Problem:** 
 The global energy transition is massive and underway, and AI and new tech are accelerating it. You'll build systems that help businesses move faster toward decarbonisation and see your work drive real decisions on real megawatts.
* **Mentorship \+ Ownership:** 
 Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with founders who care about your development. You'll get real ownership of features early, with the support to do them well.
* **High\-Performance Environment:** 
 Thrive in a results\-driven culture that values excellence, good attitude, rapid iteration, and bold innovation.
* **High\-Visibility Role:** 
 In a team this size, your work is never invisible. What you ship matters, and everyone sees it.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Strong CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and a genuine instinct for clean, correct code.
* Working proficiency in Python and/or a modern web stack (TypeScript/React); willingness to become comfortable across backend, data, and frontend.
* 0–3 years of experience (internships, projects, open\-source, or competitive programming all count) and a strong track record of learning quickly.
* Experience in data science and agentic AI workflow development.
* A solid grounding in optimisation and statistics, including undergraduate\-level mathematics (linear algebra, probability, and calculus).
* A bias toward ownership and a hunger to figure things out, you take problems from ambiguous to done, and ask good questions along the way.



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves** 



* Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, or data orchestration tools.
* Experience in a startup or other fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment.
* Interest in energy markets, climate tech, or energy policy or eagerness to build that knowledge quickly.
* Comfort with AI\-native development workflows.
* You can also reach us here: https://earthsync.io/contact\-us or careers@earthsync.io

title: PBCS Consultant
description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrating 30 years in Technology Services and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver solutions that drive customer success. Version 1 has several strategic technology partners including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems and Snowflake. We’re also an award\-winning employer reflecting how employees are at the heart of Version 1\.


We’ve been awarded: Innovation Partner of the Year Winner 2023 Oracle EMEA Partner Awards, Global Microsoft Modernising Applications Partner of the Year Award 2023, AWS Collaboration Partner of the Year \- EMEA 2023 and Best Workplaces for Women by Great Place To Work in UK and Ireland 2023\.


As a consultancy and service provider, Version 1 is a digital\-first environment and we do things differently. We’re focused on our core values; using these we’ve seen significant growth across our practices and our Digital, Data and Cloud team is preparing for the next phase of expansion. This creates new opportunities for driven and skilled individuals to join one of the fastest\-growing consultancies globally.

 **Job Description**  

Oracle PBCS Consultant with 7\+ years of end\-to\-end implementation and support experience across planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting. The ideal candidate will design and build PBCS models, lead client workshops, integrate PBCS with ERP/HR systems, and deliver reliable planning solutions with robust data governance and performance tuning.


\-

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design \& Delivery**

* Lead requirement workshops and translate financial planning needs into scalable PBCS/EPM Cloud solutions.
* Design and build Planning models (Workforce, CapEx, OpEx, Revenue, Project Planning) using EPMA/Standard Planning, Data Forms, Smart Lists, and Business Rules.
* Develop Calculation Manager rules (Groovy/Business Rules) and driver\-based models for scenario, version, and year planning.
* Configure Task Lists, Approvals (Workflow), Validations, and Security (roles, provisioning).

**Data \& Integration**

* Design and manage data integrations using Data Management, Connections, and Oracle EPM Integration Agent; build ETL mappings from ERP/GL/HR systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion ERP, EBS, SAP).
* Orchestrate data loads (files, APIs), validate data quality, and monitor integration jobs.
* Implement dimension management (hierarchies), metadata updates, and substitution variables.

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop executive\-ready reports in Oracle Reports, Dashboards, Infolets, and Smart View (Excel/Office).
* Build variance analyses, driver\-based KPIs, and board\-level reporting packs.
* Enable ad\-hoc analysis and self\-service reporting for Finance users.

**Governance, Performance \& Support**

* Establish design standards, documentation, and testing cycles (SIT, UAT).
* Optimize performance (rule tuning, form design, caching), troubleshoot issues, and drive root\-cause analysis.
* Provide hypercare, user training, and ongoing support; manage enhancements via change control.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Finance, FP\&A, and IT teams; run demos and user training.
* Manage delivery scope, risks, and timelines; contribute to effort estimation and project planning.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications**

  

* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud Planning (at least 2 full\-cycle implementations).
* Strong expertise with:


o Planning Artifacts: Forms, Rules (Groovy/Calc Manager), Approvals, Validations, Smart Lists, Sub Vars.


o Data Management/Integrations: Mappings, Load Rules, Drill\-through, Integration Agent.


o Reporting: Smart View, Dashboards, and Financial Data modeling.

* Solid understanding of FP\&A processes: Annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, rolling forecast, scenario modeling, allocations, intercompany eliminations, currency translations.
* Proficiency in SQL/CSV data handling, and performance tuning within PBCS.
* Experience with requirements gathering, solution design, and conducting UAT/training.
* Excellent communication skills and client\-facing experience.

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

  

* Groovy scripting for advanced business rules.
* Integration exposure to Oracle Fusion ERP/EBS/SAP (GL, Projects, HR).
* Knowledge of REST APIs for EPM Cloud automation.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and DevOps practices for EPM deployments.
* Experience with Workforce/Project Planning prebuilt modules.

**Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s in finance/accounting/information systems/computer science.
* Preferred: Oracle EPM Cloud certifications (Planning) or equivalent.

**Tools \& Technologies**

* Oracle EPM Cloud (PBCS/EPBCS), Calculation Manager, Groovy.
* Smart View (Excel plugin), Data Management, Integration Agent.
* SQL/Excel, REST APIs, Jira/Confluence, MS Teams.

  

**Additional Information**  

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their well\-being, professional growth, and financial stability.


One of our standout advantages is the ability to work with a hybrid schedule along with business travel, allowing our employees to strike a balance between work and life. We also offer a range of tech\-related benefits, including an innovative Tech Scheme to help keep our team members up\-to\-date with the latest technology.


We prioritise the health and safety of our employees, providing private medical and life insurance coverage, as well as free eye tests and contributions towards glasses. Our team members can also stay ahead of the curve with incentivized certifications and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat.


Our employee\-designed Profit Share scheme divides a portion of our company's profits each quarter amongst employees. We are dedicated to helping our employees reach their full potential, offering Pathways Career Development Quarterly, a programme designed to support professional growth.

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Job Description – Finance Manager**

**Position Title \- Finance Manager** 

**Department \- Finance \& Accounts**

**Experience Required \- 8 – 12 Years**

**Industry Preference \- Construction / Architecture / Interior Design / Real Estate**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Finance Manager with 8–12 years of experience in the construction, architecture, and interior design industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall financial operations of the organization, leading the finance team, ensuring financial compliance, budgeting, cost control, project finance management, and supporting strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, financial planning expertise, and experience in handling project\-based financial operations within the construction and design sector.

**Key Duties \& Responsibilities**

**1\*.** Financial Planning \& Budget Management\*

Prepare annual budgets, financial forecasts, and project cost plans.

Monitor organizational financial performance and control project expenditures.

Analyze budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

Support management with strategic financial planning and decision\-making.

**2\. Accounting \& Financial Operations**

Oversee daily accounting operations, bookkeeping, and financial transactions.

Ensure accurate maintenance of ledgers, invoices, payments, and financial records.

Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

Manage cash flow, banking operations, and fund utilization efficiently.

**3\. Project Finance \& Cost Control**

Monitor project\-wise costing, profitability, and financial performance.

Ensure proper tracking of construction and interior project expenses.

Control operational costs and optimize financial resources.

Coordinate with project teams regarding project budgets and financial approvals.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Management**

Lead, supervise, and manage the finance and accounts team effectively.

Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of financial tasks.

Provide guidance, performance monitoring, and team development support.

Ensure coordination between finance, procurement, HR, and project departments.

**5\. Compliance \& Audit Management**

Ensure compliance with financial regulations, taxation, and statutory requirements.

Handle GST, TDS, payroll compliance, and other financial statutory processes.

Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely audit closure.

Maintain proper financial documentation and compliance records.

**6\. Reporting \& Financial Analysis**

Prepare MIS reports, financial dashboards, and management reports.

Present financial insights and profitability analysis to senior management.

Monitor financial risks and recommend process improvements.

Ensure accurate reporting of project revenue, expenses, and cash flow.

**7\. Vendor \& Payment Management**

Monitor vendor payments, subcontractor billing, and payment schedules.

Verify payment approvals as per project and financial policies.

Maintain healthy financial relationships with vendors and suppliers.

Ensure proper reconciliation of accounts payable and receivable.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial management.

Expertise in project finance, budgeting, and cost control.

Knowledge of GST, taxation, statutory compliance, and audit procedures.

Strong analytical, leadership, and decision\-making skills.

Excellent communication and team management abilities.

Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools.

**Educational Qualification**

CA / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com with relevant experience.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Experience in construction, architecture, interior design, or project\-based industries.

Ability to manage multiple projects and financial operations simultaneously.

Strong leadership experience in handling finance and accounts teams.

High attention to detail, confidentiality, and organizational skills.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Director Of Engineering (Site Lead) - Spend Team
description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About The Role**


We’re building a world\-class Spend org in Bangalore and looking for a senior engineering leader to serve as our local site lead while directly owning the Accounting Integrations team. This is a rare 0 to 1 plus scale role: you’ll stand up the Bangalore hub, hire and coach managers and ICs, and ship the accounting integration platform that powers Rippling’s finance suite (corporate cards, reimbursements, travel, and accounting automation).

  

You’ll wear two hats:

* Site Lead (matrix): Be the senior presence for Spend in Bangalore—set a high bar, unblock teams, drive performance management, and ensure crisp product\<\>engineering execution across reimbursements, travel integrations, and accounting integrations.
* Direct Owner (line): Lead the Accounting Integrations team to build both the platform and the first wave of integrations (e.g., QuickBooks, Microsoft, and others). You’ll create repeatable pipelines, operational tooling, and the quality bar for how Rippling ships integrations.

  

If you thrive on ownership, love building teams and systems, and want material impact on a product with massive TAM, this is for you.

 **Why this role?**

  

* 0 to 1 with leverage: Your platform unlocks multiple product lines (Spend, Travel, Payroll).
* Massive scope: Travel \+ Spend are multibillion\-dollar markets; integrations are a core growth lever.
* Career runway: Build the Bangalore Spend org from the ground up and shape the architecture and culture that others scale

 **What You'll Do**

* Build the Bangalore hub: Hire, level, and grow a 25\+ person org; stand up rituals, on\-call, quality bars, and velocity tracking.
* Own Accounting Integrations end\-to\-end: Define the technical roadmap and delivery plan for an integrations platform that serves both Spend and Payroll; ship the next set of GA integrations.
* Raise the execution bar: Diagnose churn early, clarify requirements, and drive PR/Design quality; get teams shipping the right thing, fast.
* Manage managers \+ ICs: Mentor junior EMs; directly manage ICs initially and transition scope as leaders ramp.
* Operational excellence: Build support and observability for integrations (routing, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, data quality, SLAs).
* Partner deeply: Work with Product, Design, GTM, and Finance Ops to prioritize impact, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly.
* Scale through platforms: Establish reusable contracts, SDKs, tooling, and CI/CD standards so new integrations land in weeks—not quarters.
* Be the site leader: Set crisp goals, run calibration, address underperformance fast, and model hands\-on, detail\-oriented leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years in engineering leadership, including 2\+ years managing managers or large multi\-team groups
* Proven 0 to 1 and scale experience: shipped platforms or integrations with high reliability and throughput
* You like being technical. Strong technical depth in distributed systems, APIs/webhooks, and data modeling. Comfortable reviewing designs and PRs
* Operational mindset: built systems with monitoring, alerting, rate limits, retries, reconciliation, and clear SLOs/SLAs
* People leader: hires great talent, levels accurately, runs calibrations, manages performance with candor and speed
* Product sense: You can turn ambiguous requirements into shipped outcomes while balancing speed with quality
* Nice to have: prior work with accounting/ERP systems, travel content providers, or financial data flows

title: Team Leader
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.



A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."



* Location
Bengaluru
* Employment type
Full Time Permanent
* Department
People \& HR
* Deadline
2026\-06\-09

  
Candidate profile (title) Who you are
Candidate profile (text) \- Default language About you
  

  

Are you passionate about exceeding goals and fostering team success? Do you thrive in a fast\-paced, multi\-national environment? Are you eager to contribute to a company that prioritizes bettering everyday life for many people? If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team.
  

  

We're seeking a candidate with a strong foundation in HR with minimum 12\+ years of experience, particularly in payroll and personnel administration (PA/PY), coupled with an advanced understanding of pay\-the\-worker processes. Alongside this expertise, familiarity with HR\-related tax and legal matters is essential.
  

  

A comprehensive understanding of the IKEA HR system landscape is a definite advantage, as is proficiency in modern office practices, procedures, and equipment. While a basic understanding of the IKEA system is required, we're also looking for candidates who demonstrate potential management or leadership skills, as this role may involve guiding and leading teams toward shared objectives.
  

  

You
  

  

* have passion for working with people and you successfully lead them by example,
* communication in English is your strong point, and you are eager to use it while cooperating with various partners all over the world
* bring a true passion for people and enjoy working in a vibrant and changing environment,
* thrive in a dynamic, fast\-changing environment and are passionate about transitions and driving change.
* have a service oriented and customer focused background, a strong drive and the ability to take decisions and delegate,
* have understanding and passion for IKEA values and want to share it with your team.
* have strong knowledge of HR Processes (including Payroll) (with min. 5 years of experience) preferably IN (India) HR processes and with min 3\-5yrs of People Manager experience.
* build strong relationships and collaborate easily with different stakeholders
* are well\-organized, proactive, and able to prioritize effectively

  

Last, but not least – you are a true ambassador for IKEA Culture and Values.
Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us
Key responsibilities (text) As the leader of a GBO People Services team, you're responsible to lead one of the GBO People Services teams for India, which is responsible for P\&C processes (Personnel Administration, Payroll, Recruitment, Onboarding, Offboarding, Benefits, Learning and Development) as per defined and agreed scope, execute delivery of services on high professional standard and strive to meet or exceed agreed service levels.
  

  

As a People Services Team Leader you will:
  

* Lead the country Personnel Administration/Payroll team to deliver high\-quality services efficiently, including monthly and yearly activities.
* To ensure efficient and high\-quality PA/PY service delivery in line with global procedures and local legal requirements.
* Adhere to defined KPIs/SLAs.
* Act as an expert, leading solution implementation.
* Develop team competence through coaching and training.
* Resolve issues, manage escalations, and follow up on outstanding topics in promptly and a timely manner.
* Drive continuous process improvement.
* Closely cooperate with Project Leader to secure migration plan for any transferring/transitioning services.
* Active participation \& coordination in relevant project deliverables
* Foster strong relationships with partners.
* Allocate resources effectively and create a motivated, high\-performing team environment
* Manage, coach, and develop team members, strengthening their knowledge, skills, and engagement.
* Recruit and onboard competent new co\-workers that will fit the team with the required PA/PY profiles
* Motivate the team to deliver outstanding service.
* Promote a culture where IKEA values are a strong and visible part of everyday work.
* Actively contributes to project deliverables and foster strong relationships with stakeholders.

This role is situated within Bangalore and will report directly to the GBO Service Delivery Manager or GBO People Services Manager for India. Also, this role requires working from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM to support India customers, with the flexibility to extend working hours when needed.
Team vision ( title) About this work area
Team vision (text) Global Business Operation (GBO) is a function within the IKEA Group of companies. We work with transactional services in the field of Finance and HR. We deliver our services through our regional hubs, located in Poznan, Shanghai, Bangalore and Baltimore.
### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home\-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.  

  

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co\-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.  

  

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.
### **What we all have in common**


* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing \& delivering while learning \& developing
* Having fun!
company_description: At IKEA, we share an inspiring vision: “to create a better everyday life for the many people”.

description:
**About Durapid Technologies**
 Durapid Technologies is a fast\-growing IT company specializing in IT Contractual Staffing, AI Software Development, Data \& AI Practices, and Enterprise Software Development. We are proud to be a Microsoft Partner in Data and AI, enabling us to deliver world\-class solutions powered by Microsoft Azure, Fabric, Power BI, Copilot, and the broader Microsoft AI ecosystem. We work with businesses globally to deliver cutting\-edge technology solutions and build high\-performance tech teams. At Durapid, we believe in building not just great products, but a people\-first culture rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a dynamic and people\-driven Human Resource Business Partner (HRBP) to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as a strategic link between the HR function and business operations, ensuring that our talent strategies are aligned with organizational goals. You will work closely with leadership and employees across IT staffing, AI development, and enterprise solution verticals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning**
* Partner with hiring managers to define job requirements and drive end\-to\-end recruitment for technical and non\-technical roles
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline for IT staffing and AI development verticals
* Collaborate on workforce planning to meet project and business demands


**Employee Relations \& Engagement**
* Act as the primary point of contact for employee queries
* Drive employee engagement initiatives that foster a positive, inclusive, and high\-performance culture
* Conduct regular one\-on\-ones and pulse checks to monitor team morale and well\-being


**Performance Management**
* Support and facilitate performance review cycles, goal\-setting, and KPI tracking
* Work with managers to develop Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) where necessary
* Identify high\-potential employees and recommend development programs


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Manage onboarding, offboarding, and employee lifecycle processes
* Maintain HR records, documentation, and HRMS data accurately
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory requirements, and company HR policies
* Handle payroll inputs, leave management, and attendance coordination


**Learning \& Development**
* Identify training needs in coordination with team leads and project managers
* Coordinate and facilitate L\&D programs to upskill employees across technology and soft skills
* Support leadership development and succession planning


**Strategic HR Partnership**
* Partner with leadership on org design, team structuring, and change management
* Provide HR data insights, reports, and dashboards to support business decisions
* Champion Durapid's culture and values as the company scales


**Required Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* 2\+ years of hands\-on HRBP or HR Generalist experience, preferably in an IT or technology company
* Working knowledge of HR practices including recruitment, performance management, employee relations, and compliance
* Familiarity with Indian labor laws and statutory requirements (PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.)
* Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and HR software tools
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills
* High emotional intelligence and the ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion


**Preferred / Good To Have Skills**
* Prior exposure to IT staffing, contractual hiring, or consulting environments
* Experience supporting AI, data, or software development teams
* Familiarity with ATS platforms and HRMS tools
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret HR metrics and trends

description:
Are you a builder who learns by doing? Do you spend your free time tinkering with code, breaking things, and fixing them just to see how they work? If so, we want to talk to you.

We are looking for a motivated **Mobile App Developer** with a passion for **Flutter and Kotlin** to join our team in a flexible, internship\-style collaboration. We don’t care about a perfect 5\-page corporate resume or decades of formal job experience. **We care about your ability to build real, functioning software.**

Whether you are a student, a self\-taught developer, a recent graduate, or an engineer transitioning from another stack—if you have a GitHub repository full of experimental projects, freelance work, or college apps you are proud of, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)**

As a core contributor to our mobile ecosystem, you won't just be fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. You will be treating this like a real product ownership role. You will:

* **Build \& Iterate:** Develop, test, and deploy new mobile app features using Flutter and Kotlin.
* **Craft UI/UX:** Translate design wireframes into smooth, responsive, and pixel\-perfect user interfaces.
* **Connect Systems:** Integrate backend services, RESTful APIs, and cloud databases (like Firebase).
* **Debug \& Optimize:** Hunt down bugs, profile app performance, and continuously iterate based on user feedback.
* **Influence Product:** Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute directly to product development decisions. Your voice matters here.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Core:** Flutter with Web support (Dart) \& Backend (Kotlin)
* **Plus Skills (Nice to have):** Firebase ecosystem, REST APIs, Git/Version Control, and general Flutter knowledge.

**Who You Are (Requirements)**

We are looking for a specific mindset rather than a specific degree. You are a great fit if you possess:

* **Hands\-on Building Ability:** You have already built and deployed (or at least run locally) real projects.
* **High Curiosity \& Ownership:** You don't just wait for instructions. You look at a problem, research solutions, and take ownership of the outcome.
* **Independent Problem\-Solving:** You are comfortable digging through documentation, Stack Overflow, or AI tools to unblock yourself when you get stuck.
* **Consistency:** Because this is a remote and flexible role, you must be a disciplined self\-starter who can communicate effectively and hit agreed\-upon milestones.

*This Role is Ideal For:*

* **Students \& Freshers** looking for high\-impact, real\-world development exposure to supercharge their portfolios.
* **Self\-Taught Developers** who need a platform to prove their skills on a production\-level app.
* **Engineers Transitioning** from web or backend development into the mobile space.

What We Offer

* **True Flexibility:** Work from anywhere, at any time that suits your schedule, provided deadlines are met.
* **Mentorship \& Growth:** Work on real\-world problems that will teach you more in a few months than a year in a lecture hall.
* **Portfolio Building:** Ship code that you can actually point to and say, *"I built that feature."*

**How to Apply**

To skip the corporate red tape, please include the following in your application:

* A link to your **GitHub profile, portfolio, or specific app repositories** (Applications without code samples will not be considered).
* A brief summary or links to **projects you’ve built** and what your role was in creating them.
* A **short introduction** about yourself, your coding journey, and why you want to work with Flutter/Kotlin.
* Your **current availability** (how many hours per week you can consistently dedicate to this collaboration).

description:
**Job Title:** Customer Support \& Operations Executive  
**Company:** KNV Ventures (parent company of a growing Indian D2C brand)  
**Location:** Remote \- India  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month **Experience:** 0–2 years (freshers welcome)

**About Us**

KNV Ventures is the parent company behind a fast\-growing Indian D2C health brand. We sell health supplements directly to customers across India and we're scaling quickly. As we grow, we need someone to own customer support and day\-to\-day operations so our customers always have a smooth experience.

→ To apply, you must fill out our short application form (link at the bottom). Applications without the form will not be reviewed.

**Role Overview**

We're hiring a Customer Support \& Operations Executive who will be the main point of contact for our customers and the person who keeps our orders moving smoothly.

On the support side, you'll help customers with all their questions, whether it's about the product itself or about their order. Most of this happens over WhatsApp and email, with the occasional inbound call (call volume is low, so this is a small part of the role). Customers will ask things like how the product works, when their parcel will arrive, or why a delivery is delayed, and you'll guide them clearly and patiently across whichever channel they reach out on.

On the operations side, you'll manage the shipping side of things end to end. This means handling NDRs (non\-delivery reports), managing RTO (return to origin) orders, raising and tracking tickets on shipping aggregator platforms, and coordinating with courier partners. Since you're already the one talking to customers, you'll also keep them updated on their order status and resolve any delivery issues directly with them.

In short, you'll own both the conversation with the customer and the journey of their order, making sure both run smoothly from start to finish.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Fluent in English and Hindi, comfortable communicating clearly over WhatsApp, email, and the occasional call
* Strong written communication, you can explain things simply and politely in text
* Organized and detail\-oriented, able to juggle support conversations and shipping tasks at the same time
* Calm and patient when handling customer concerns or delivery issues
* Has a laptop/computer, stable internet, and a quiet workspace
* Available to work 10 AM – 7 PM IST, Monday to Saturday
* Available to start within 7–10 days

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

* Experience with Shopify
* Experience with shipping tools (Shiprocket, Delhivery One, iThink Logistics, Nimbuspost)
* Experience with WhatsApp tools (Zoko, KwikEngage, Interakt, Wati)
* Prior customer support or e\-commerce operations experience

**What We Offer**

* ₹15,000/month to start, with a clear path to ₹20,000–₹25,000 after a 3\-month performance review based on your performance
* Work directly with the founder and learn how a D2C brand runs end to end
* Fully remote, work from anywhere in India
* Real growth opportunity as the company scales into a role with more responsibility and ownership

title: Customer Support Manager - HRIS
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-First Mindset: A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

**The team:**



Customer is about much more than just the numbers. It’s about attesting to accomplishments and challenges and helping to assure strong foundations for future aspirations. Deloitte exemplifies the what, how, and why of change so you’re always ready to act ahead. Learn more about Customer



  

**Job Responsibilities:**



We are looking for a Consultant/Senior Consultant/Manager for Customer Strategy and Applied design focused on Strategy \& Operations. The role involves responsibility for leading a discrete work stream or module on a large\-scale project or overall delivery lead in case of short term/ small scale engagement. The key focus sectors would be TMT organizations.



For instance, on a Strategy project for a telecommunication company, focused on recommending strategies for revenue uplift – involving market assessment, conducting primary/ secondary research, analyzing competitor landscape, strategies, pricing models and market share, deep dive analysis on selected KPIs, data analytics, building a financial model to estimate potential revenue and costs under different scenarios, identify key regulatory considerations and partnership opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategy and presenting findings/ recommendations to the client’s leadership teams. The extent of analysis, hands\-on implementation expected varies from case to case, and depends on the size of the team and scope of the project.



The responsibilities can include:


* Build and maintain a solid understanding of the client's business objectives and processes to become a trusted advisor for all issues related to business strategy, operations, performance, revenue generation and cost optimization.
* Develop/define \& implement strategic programs to enhance business penetration \& increase revenues for the client, or rationalize costs.
* Identify and make recommendations for actions to improve business performance and drive incremental revenue.
* Working with internal teams, and clients to develop and implement long term and short term engagement objectives and work plan
* Thinking through a solution lens and working with client and Deloitte’s teams to deliver engagements


* Leading small client and internal teams to understand, design, enhance, confirm and deliver objectives of the engagement


* Working in alignment with the internal and client team to ensure a streamlined delivery model with seamless integration of the final deliverable across modules
* Communicating, analysis, recommendations and status updates in both written and oral communication with internal and client leadership
* Report writing and preparation of final deliverable
* Assisting seniors in responding to client requests, RFPs and problem statements with proposals
* Building the relationship between Deloitte and the client’s project team


**Job Qualifications:**



Successful candidates will have a degree from a top\-tier MBA, Engineering, BBA or B.Com. Program, have 1\-2 years (C), 3\+years (SC), 8\+years (M) of relevant business experience, and the ability to meet each of the following criteria:


* An entry level (C) or expert level of knowledge (SC or M) in telecom business, operating model, product \& pricing strategies, marketing, sales\-distribution, and data analysis techniques
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting specially in thinking through large andcomplex engagements
* Background or experience (through coursework or employment) in TMT organization (optional for freshers)
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Leadership qualities, project management skills, and the ability to mentor
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* Candidates from all academic backgrounds are encouraged to apply


* Willingness for long term international or domestic travel



Personal Qualities Valued:

title: Business Analyst
description:
**About Lokal :**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (LokalMatrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, SahiJobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
   

  

 We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
   

  

**Role Overview :**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical Business Analyst / Data Analyst to support data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. This role involves working closely with business, product, and operations teams to analyze data, generate insights, improve processes, and translate business needs into actionable solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, building dashboards, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive measurable business impact.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities :**
* Key Responsibilities:
* Gather, evaluate, and prioritize business and technical requirements from stakeholders
* Collaborate closely with business, product, and operations teams to ensure alignment and clarity
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business insights
* Build dashboards and reports to track key business metrics and performance
* Translate business questions into structured analytical problems
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend data\-driven improvements
* Support forecasting, performance tracking, and decision\-making initiatives
* Assist in designing and implementing business solutions backed by data insights
* Document business requirements, process flows, and key definitions clearly
* Present insights, recommendations, and findings effectively to stakeholders


**Requirements**
* Strong SQL and Excel proficiency
* Experience with dashboards/visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio)
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to translate business questions into data analysis
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills


**Why Join Us?**
 We're scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you'll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

**Value Creation (Execution Support)** 



* Contribute to the successful delivery of learning and enablement programs.
* Improve visibility into progress through accurate reporting and tracking.

**Delivery (Execution \& Reliability)** 



* Track learning initiatives and ensure milestones are met on time.
* Prepare reports and dashboards to monitor progress and performance.
* Support day\-to\-day operational activities that enable smooth program execution.
* Maintain documentation and ensure data accuracy across systems and trackers.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 We’re seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented individual who enjoys coordination, tracking progress, and ensuring tasks are completed on time. The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple moving parts simultaneously. You should have strong follow\-up skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain structure in a fast\-paced environment. This internship is well\-suited for students or recent graduates who want to build foundational skills in operations, coordination, and program management while gaining exposure to real\-world learning and development initiatives.

**Education:** 




 Students or recent graduates from any discipline.

**Mindset:** 




 Reliable, proactive, structured, and execution\-focused with a willingness to learn.

 Develop practical skills in reporting, stakeholder coordination, and operational planning.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As Talent Acquisition Specialist in the Global Businesses and Functions Recruiting team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of recruiting activities for a diverse range of roles in our team’s portfolio. In partnership with other key members of the GBF TA team, you will manage the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offers for all candidates in a multi\-faceted regional setting. You will be responsible for maintaining high quality standards and delivering a positive experience for all candidates and stakeholders at each phase of the recruiting process. To successfully lead the internal and external recruiting efforts, you possess excellent communication, relationship, and process management skills and build positive and lasting partnerships with internal hiring managers, the GS/GSB HR Teams, HR in local offices, and other stakeholders.

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* 2\+ years of recruitment/talent acquisition experience in international markets and complex matrixed organizations or a high\-touch recruiting agency
* Understanding of market talent pools, sourcing channels, hiring trends, cultural norms, compensation benchmarks
* Previous in\-house full lifecycle recruiting experience, ideally within Shared Service Centers or a volume hiring environment preferred
* Strong behavioral and competency\-based interviewing experience required
* Deep knowledge and proven success of utilizing LinkedIn Recruiter for successful talent engagement and pipelining
* Well versed with Applicant Tracking Systems, recruiting analytics tools, and digital communication tools like Trello, Slack, Sharepoint, strong proficiency with Microsoft Suite
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in English, in addition other European languages preferred
* Ability to be responsive and effective in a fast\-paced yet consensus\-driven corporate culture, to multitask and operate effectively in a matrix organization
* Experience building internal network with senior leaders and advising senior stakeholders as subject matter expert
* Ability to drive efficient processes and show operational effectiveness

  

Who You'll Work With


As part of the GBF (Global Businesses \& Functions) Talent Acquisition team, Global Services and other BST business units to attract and select top talent across the system, the region and globally through: Best\-in\-class recruiting, innovative sourcing, and an engaging talent brand.

  

In this role you will work closely with the larger People team, including Talent Acquisition, HR, mobility, and the various business leads.

  

Additional info

**You are good at**

* In order to successfully lead the internal and external full lifecycle recruiting efforts, you will have excellent relationship and process management skills and be effective in building lasting partnerships with Hiring managers, the respective HR Teams, HR in local offices and 3rd parties (if applicable).
* Areas of ownership for you include:
* Full lifecycle management of vacancies across a diverse range of corporate \& digital functions primarily focused in India across Corporate Functions roles include People, Finance, Admin Assistants \& Executive Support, Marketing, Operations.
* Manage key stakeholder relationships as a trusted partner and valued hiring partner, building a deep understanding of their business, function knowledge and/or technical skills, role requirements and desired candidate profiles
* Leveraging internal talent sources to drive mobility, employee referrals and alumni engagement in the region
* Identify high quality candidates through the proactive identification of candidates via direct channels, job postings, social media, web sourcing, talent mapping, vendors, networking \& innovative sourcing techniques
* Conduct first round interviews for all suitable candidates, providing a competency\-based assessment and fact\-based candidate recommendation
* Build talent pipelines to fill current and future roles to drive improvements in quality and time to hire
* Manage recruitment campaigns for any volume hiring needs or brand building events
* Utilize the applicant tracking system to actively track, manage and report on candidate pipelines to enhance stakeholder communication and ensure effective process management
* Articulation of the global talent brand and candidate value proposition to talent in the region and talent markets in individual countries
* Support the regional recruitment strategy by contributing to and implementing regional initiatives to global projects; locally identify and implement improvements creatively
* Manage and improve the candidate experience through efficient process management and continuous communication
* Review key metrics and performance measures for the region such as time to hire, cost per hire and quality of hire, and recommend enhancements wherever possible
* Ensure global best practices are embedded in the region to drive operational effectiveness through process improvements and the ongoing coaching and mentoring of hiring managers
* Partner and collaborate closely with the regions HR and systems Recruiting teams to enhance the quality of hiring decisions

**Equal Opportunity**

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Regional Facilities Manager
  
Workplace Dynamics
  
  

OVERALL ROLE
  
This role oversees the end\-to\-end operations within the assigned portfolio of India, covering offices in Bengaluru, Mumbai and Gurgaon. The primary objective is to deliver an exceptional workplace experience by prioritizing human\-centric, engagement\-focused activities. Responsibilities include managing teams, site operations, service contracts, sourcing, procurement, and financial decisions—all aimed at achieving operational excellence while ensuring safe working practices in all aspects.
  
  

This role serves as the primary liaison between the client and the JLL team for workplace activities. It supports account initiatives by ensuring consistent implementation of operational excellence and service delivery. A key part of this role is fostering engagement and collaboration with other regions and local JLL teams as needed, interacting with various lines of business and occupants to provide an exceptional service experience.
  
  

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

**Leadership \& Team Management:**  

Experienced in actively encouraging an environment of teamwork, cooperation, high performance and individuals success, you will realise that the team’s success means your success
  
Your style of people management will be proactive. You will engage in building a deep understanding of your teams aspirations and career goals, you will be committed to coaching, mentoring and tackling issues head on by building plans to address areas of development
  
Team development will be thoughtfully achieved through skills and performance assessments, timely training, regular 1:1’s, follow ups and oversight will allow you to manage your team’s workload
  
Understanding the criticality of hiring, promoting or developing the right people at the right time, you will engage closely with internal COE’s and HR to effectively resource and build workforce planning and succession plans for our teams and vendors
  
Encouraging your teams to engage with peers on other accounts, attending JLL Integrated Facilities Management events to share knowledge, best practice and sharing market updates will be a key focus
  
  

**Operations:**  

Further development of SOP’s and ensuring smooth procedural implementation will provide seamless service. You will be skilled in simplification and accuracy improvement of work methods to ensure reliability of systems and consistency of delivery
  
Critical to the role, your input on developing space planning ideas and strategies that meet the changing demands of the business creating both strategic and tactical solutions is key
  
You’ll play an important role in supporting the delivery of major/minor works projects and associated moves / changes are done in accordance to the guidelines set by our Client
  
Budgeting and spend management will be a finely tuned skill, you will own financial processes and controls to ensure that the country’s financial operations are meeting or exceeding targets
  
Educating your team on compliance with JLL and our Client’s H\&SE (health \& safety environment) and Risk Management policies and procedures
  
A component of your role will be supporting UX (User Experience) programs, new technology system / tool roll\-outs, training programs / workshops etc, through driving implementation and consistency
  
Reporting, analysis, data driven decisions will be your core skillset, you’ll be confident and well informed when conducting presentations
  
  

**Sourcing \& Vendor Management:**  

Oversee all vendor contracts to ensure that they are professionally delivered with value for money outcomes, well\-monitored and re\-negotiated as required to ensure the best value to the Client
  
Ensure the strategic sourcing initiatives across the portfolio are followed and all the JLL provided tools are utilised.
  
Provide guidance to the site teams to ensure appropriate processes are followed to conduct major sourcing/procurement activities
  
Ensure vendors performance is managed, and all services are delivered as per the contract
  
  

Client/Stakeholder Management (in support of the Account Executive)
  
Develop and manage Client relationships, ensuring that programs and projects implemented are aligned with Client’s vision, priorities and targets
  
Comply with all requirements of the Client contract, meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators
  
Deliver an exceptional quality of service to the Client
  
  

Quality Management
  
Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance protocols in accordance with internal standards and industry best practices.
  
Conduct regular quality audits and inspections to assess compliance, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  
Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to address quality\-related issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  
Track, analyze, and report on key quality metrics and KPIs to inform strategic decision\-making.
  
Foster a culture of quality across the team through training, process documentation, and knowledge sharing.
  
  

**CANDIDATE SPECIFICATION:** KEY SELECTION CRITERIA
  
Ideal Experience
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as presentation skills
  
Able to adapt in a fast\-paced working environment and versatile in meeting client changing needs and requirements
  
Strong analytical, organization and administration skills
  
A minimum of 6 years in the facility management industry/hospitality industry
  
An added benefit would be a Bachelor’s degree in hospitality or other related field; however, this is not a must
  
Deep understanding of the workplace environment and a keen interest in emerging technologies and trends relevant to the workplace.
  
  

Other Personal Characteristics
  
Strong communications and customer focus skills with the ability to interface and relate to the different stakeholders in the organization
  
Confident, friendly \& engaging
  
Creative thinking with an open mind that is balanced by a strong sense of realism and practicality
  
Open to new ideas \& willing to challenge status quo
  
Works well with diverse teams from various countries/cultures
  
  

KEY STAKEHOLDERS
  
Management Staff
  
Client Representatives
  
Client Occupants / End\-users
  
Vendor Staff
  
  

REPORTING TO
  
APAC Account Executive
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Strong academic foundation with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline, complemented by continuous learning and exposure to enterprise\-scale operating models.

description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) acts as a strategic partner to business leaders, aligning HR strategies with business objectives. This role focuses on driving organizational effectiveness, talent management, employee engagement, and change initiatives while ensuring compliance with HR policies and practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Strategic HR Partnership** 



* Collaborate with business leaders to understand organizational goals and translate them into HR initiatives
* Drive workforce planning, organizational design, and succession planning
* Act as a trusted advisor on people\-related matters



**2\. Talent Management \& Development** 



* Lead performance management processes and ensure goal alignment
* Identify high\-potential employees and create development plans
* Partner with L\&D teams to implement capability\-building initiatives



**3\. Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Drive employee engagement initiatives and surveys
* Address employee concerns and foster a positive work environment
* Promote company values and culture across the organization



**4\. Employee Relations** 



* Manage complex employee relations issues with a balanced approach
* Ensure fair and consistent application of policies and disciplinary actions
* Support conflict resolution and grievance handling



**5\. Change Management** 



* Support organizational change initiatives such as restructuring, mergers, or transformation programs
* Guide leaders and employees through change with effective communication strategies



**6\. HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure adherence to labor laws and company policies
* Partner with HR operations for seamless execution of HR processes (onboarding, exits, payroll inputs, etc.)
* Analyze HR metrics and provide actionable insights



**7\. Stakeholder Management** 



* Build strong relationships with leadership and cross\-functional teams
* Collaborate with COEs (Centers of Excellence) like Talent Acquisition, Compensation \& Benefits, and L\&D



  





**Key Requirements** 



* Master’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred)
* 8–12 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5\+ years in an HRBP role
* Strong business acumen and understanding of HR best practices
* Proven experience in stakeholder management and influencing leadership
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and interpersonal skills



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking
* Influencing and negotiation
* Data\-driven decision making
* Change agility
* Emotional intelligence



  





**KPIs / Success Metrics** 



* Employee engagement scores
* Attrition and retention rates
* Leadership satisfaction
* Talent development and succession outcomes
* HR process efficiency

description:
**Job Description**
 The role focuses on handling data coming from multiple sources and formats, designing automation tools for data processing, and ensuring high\-quality data ingestion into a SQL\-based application.
   

  

 This position is ideal for candidates with a strong interest in ETL processes, data automation, and applied AI, who are eager to grow in a technically rich and evolving environment. Exposure to environmental data is considered a valuable plus.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage and integrate data from multiple heterogeneous sources and formats (e.g., structured, semi\-structured, manual inputs).
* Design and implement ETL workflows to automate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes where possible.
* Develop and maintain automation tools and scripts to improve data reliability, efficiency, and scalability.
* Perform manual data entry and data validation activities when automation is not feasible, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
* Load, maintain, and update datasets within an application backed by a SQL database, ensuring adherence to data quality standards.
* Support data monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of data pipelines.
* Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and propose improvements.
* Contribute to exploratory activities related to AI\-driven data processing, data enrichment, or intelligent automation use cases.


**Qualifications**
 Required Skills and Qualifications
   

  

* Educational background or hands\-on experience in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related fields with 1 – 2 years of professional experience in similar role
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of ETL concepts and data pipelines.
* Experience with SQL databases (querying, loading, basic data modeling).
* Familiarity with at least one scripting or programming language commonly used in data processing (e.g., Python).
* Ability to work with data from multiple formats and sources (CSV, Excel, databases, APIs, etc.).
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy.
* Analytical mindset with problem\-solving attitude.
* Good communication skills and ability to work both independently and within a team.
* Curiosity, passion for data and AI, and willingness to continuously learn and evolve.

* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools or frameworks (e.g., custom pipelines, open\-source or commercial ETL platforms).
* Exposure to AI / Machine Learning concepts, especially in relation to data preparation, enrichment, or automation.

* Familiarity with data visualization or reporting tools.
